name: pie-chart
title: Pie chart
description: Slices of one whole that sweep around on scroll. Hover a slice or legend row and it pulls out.
htmlExample:
<bef-pie-chart class="w-[32rem] max-w-full" :data='[{"label":"Pro plan","value":48},{"label":"Business","value":31},{"label":"Starter","value":14,"color":"text-warning"},{"label":"Add-ons","value":7,"color":"text-info"}]' id="g1"></bef-pie-chart>
<script type="module">
document.getElementById("g1").props = {
  format: (n) => `₹${n}L`,
};
</script>
